headline: Break slid west to Santa Rosa Flats — go today, fog first
body:
No advisories, but patchy dense fog is the real hazard this morning, visibility 1 NM or less in the channel and outer waters. Thursday is otherwise the soft day: light winds through midday, W 5–10 by afternoon, 2–3 ft in the channel and 3.4 ft out in the triangle. Friday gives up less sea, 3 ft, but W 10–20 fills in by afternoon with 10 kn and gusts to 11 over the zone, so the window closes earlier.

The break is not in the triangle. All three corners run warm and flat — west 70.8, south point 71.1, east 71.3 today, with Friday nearly identical. Nothing near the red isotherm, let alone the black.

The coolest water on the chart is Santa Rosa Flats at 68.6 today, just outside the band and worth the 40 nm if you want a real edge. Start the west corner south of Santa Cruz on 70.8, then push northwest. Osborn at 71.5 and San Nicolas at 70.4 are not worth the run.
